digest.component_or_area: jira-sync bridge test harness, multi-project rehearsal
propositions: Non-existent Jira project keys cause parse errors and fail-closed behavior, which a stateful fake transport cannot reproduce; the live DC rehearsal must validate this with real ephemeral projects.

Cross-project contamination (mutations in one project leaking to another) cannot be detected without real isolated projects and dry-run gating via preview; the rehearsal must preview-gate every mutating scenario and assert target projects contain only intended mutations.

The ephemeral Jira DC instance provides admin rights and throwaway project creation/teardown per run, enabling reproducible CI-verified multi-project scenarios in jira-dc-harness job where live Cloud's two shared projects cannot model three repo shapes plus empty and unknown paths.
Project capability provisioning must verify issue types and fields before any scenario runs; a degrade in real DC must fail provisioning rather than later scenarios.

Cleanup via session-scoped finalizers must delete all scratch projects on every exit path including mid-run failures; per-run random RBJ-prefixed keys and session guards prevent cross-run data pollution.
